1.1.0.en: BETA — big update: arm/disarm per area, richer Flow cards (detector alarmed with snapshot, armed/disarmed, area conditions, arm/disarm/bypass/siren actions), panel health (mains-power-lost, tamper), low-battery & offline alarms, PIR-CAM snapshot on alarm, add detectors without re-adding the panel, device Repair to change IP/password, and 15 languages. Hardening from a 4-agent code review: fixed a session leak that kept logging in after devices were removed, the alertStream now reconnects if the panel drops it (snapshots keep working), Repair now takes effect immediately (no stale-password lockout risk), login backoff + logout-before-relogin so the panel is never flooded, arm/disarm/bypass/siren now surface panel errors, no duplicate alarms on app restart, and per-detector snapshot tokens.
1.1.0.sv: BETA — stor uppdatering: till-/frånkoppling per område, rikare Flow-kort (detektor larmade med bild, till-/frånkopplat, områdesvillkor, actions arma/frånkoppla/bypassa/siren), panelhälsa (nätström borta, sabotage), larm för lågt batteri & offline, PIR-CAM-bild vid larm, lägg till detektorer utan att re-adda panelen, Reparera-flöde för IP/lösen, och 15 språk. Härdning efter en granskning med 4 agenter: fixat en sessionsläcka som fortsatte logga in efter att enheter tagits bort, alertStream återansluter nu om panelen tappar den (bilder fortsätter fungera), Reparera biter nu direkt (ingen risk för kontolåsning av gammalt lösen), login-backoff + logout-före-relogin så panelen aldrig floodas, arm/frånkoppla/bypassa/siren visar nu panelfel, inga dubbla larm vid appomstart, och per-detektor-bildtokens.

1.1.1.en: Arm/disarm each area independently, richer Flow cards (alarm triggered, armed/disarmed, area conditions, arm/disarm/bypass/siren actions), panel health (mains-power-lost, tamper), low-battery & offline alerts, more reliable alarm detection, Repair to change IP/password without re-adding, add detectors without re-adding the panel, and 15 languages.
1.1.1.sv: Till-/frankoppling per omrade, rikare Flow-kort, panelhalsa (natstrom borta, sabotage), larm for lagt batteri & offline, mer tillforlitlig larmdetektion, Reparera for att byta IP/losen utan att re-adda, lagg till detektorer utan att re-adda panelen, och 15 sprak.

1.1.2.en: Corrected the store description (the app no longer mentions a local camera snapshot, which is not available on current AX PRO firmware).
1.1.2.sv: Rattad butiksbeskrivning (appen namner inte langre en lokal kamera-ognablicksbild, som inte finns pa nuvarande AX PRO-firmware).

1.1.4.en: New photo-based app and device images. Battery: each detector now uses a single battery indicator (measure_battery) instead of two, so there is no more duplicate battery component - Homey still flags a low battery automatically. Devices added with an earlier version are cleaned up automatically when you update.
1.1.4.sv: Nya foto-baserade app- och enhetsbilder. Batteri: varje detektor anvander nu en enda batteriindikator (measure_battery) i stallet for tva, sa dubbla batterikomponenten forsvinner - Homey varnar fortfarande automatiskt vid lagt batteri. Enheter som lades till med en tidigare version stadas automatiskt nar du uppdaterar.

1.1.5.en: New App Store artwork: the app image now shows the AX PRO system (panel, motion detector and door contact) on a Hikvision-style background, distinct from the device images.
1.1.5.sv: Ny butiksbild: appbilden visar nu AX PRO-systemet (panel, rorelsedetektor och dorrkontakt) pa en bakgrund i Hikvision-stil, skild fran enhetsbilderna.

1.1.7.en: Gentler on the panel: status polling now runs every 30 seconds instead of every 5. Alarms still arrive instantly over the real-time event stream, so nothing feels slower - the panel just gets a lot less traffic.
1.1.7.sv: Snallare mot centralen: statusavlasningen sker nu var 30:e sekund i stallet for var 5:e. Larm kommer fortfarande direkt via realtidsstrommen, sa inget kanns langsammare - centralen slipper bara massor av trafik.

1.1.8.en: Fixes arming on newer panel firmware (e.g. V1.3.1 build 251113), where arm returned 404 while disarm worked: arm/disarm/bypass now use the panel's JSON form of the command and fall back to the older form, and whole-system arming falls back to per-area commands if the panel rejects the all-areas id. Homey now refreshes the panel state right after arm/disarm. Shock/vibration detectors (incl. combined magnet+shock contacts) now show a shock trigger as a generic alarm. Pairing errors are short and readable, with the full detail in the app log. Login negotiation tolerates newer capability responses. A one-time, log-only diagnostic summary (model, firmware, field names - no values) helps support from a diagnostic report.
1.1.8.sv: Rattar tillkoppling pa nyare panel-firmware (t.ex. V1.3.1 build 251113) dar tillkoppling gav 404 medan frankoppling fungerade: till-/frankoppling/bypass anvander nu panelens JSON-form av kommandot med fallback till den aldre formen, och tillkoppling av hela systemet faller tillbaka pa per-omrade om panelen avvisar alla-omraden-id:t. Homey uppdaterar nu panelens lage direkt efter till-/frankoppling. Stotdetektorer (inkl. kombinerade magnet+stot-kontakter) visar nu stot som generellt larm. Parningsfel ar korta och lasbara, med full detalj i appens logg. Inloggningen tal nyare capabilities-svar. En engangs diagnossammanfattning (modell, firmware, faltnamn - inga varden) i loggen underlattar support via diagnostikrapport.
